title: Construct two-site caller cleanup and certify fixed-word retiming floors
body:
## Summary

Two existing unary replacements and deletion of the whole U-coordinate tail recovery improve the complete q2/q3 J callers from **stock+8 to stock+4**. The actual profiles are `H2=36,H4=1` (mass76, stock72) and `H2=64,H4=1` (mass132, stock128). Every original field retains its literal `F_k J` output gauge.

The construction attains the isolated whole-bank Clifford rank-distance bound `r(U)+r(W)≥|r(L)−r(R)|`: exact Gaussian Bruhat factors make U a physical monomial and W one native2f child. Quadratic Z phases and whole-field Gaussian units are retained. Offline L/R factorizations are not executed as uncharged native queries; monomial/ADD/scalar scans remain paid.

Four new exact crossed-path certificates also prove rank mass at least stock for arbitrary Clifford-frame retiming of the named repaired and two-site q2/q3 words. Every holonomy is full ambient rank, giving floors72/128. This maximizes the path-certificate objective; it does not prove source masses76/132 or80/136 optimal.

## Scope and limits

The actual callers cover q2/q3 and every positive f, with every independent original field, both serialized inverse orders and all selected-native recipes. The general rank-distance lemma has its own isolated-interface premises. The retiming theorem fixes each unary/common-frame ADD graph and literal physical boundaries; gauges may mix tensor coordinates. Changed responses, helper couplings, scalar rewrites across native sites or endpoint contracts need a new certificate. No universal-J or arbitrary same-matrix caller bound follows.

The post-mass76 census covers all7 nonempty remaining-tail subsets and703 existing prefix pairs each. All4,921 cases fail the declared single-bank/two-sided-isolation premises. This same-engine reproduction has independent scope controls and is not a global two-site optimum.

Scientific base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority6, remains pinned. Canonical main advanced to `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f` with only an unrelated sparse-baseline helper/test change; guidance, selected record and catalogue are unchanged. The explicit donor continuation changes the `joint-query-controller` card's scope; the broad original card is not solved. [PR4074](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4074) at `5758f0f3042b740ce872b5b0ae974917bd07016d` is the direct source; [PR4069](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4069) retains fixed-core/native ancestry. Fresh bounded overlap and exact related heads are recorded; coverage is partial.

No favorable supplier, all-q caller, global optimum, physical owner/controller/precision/tape admission, compatible BIT, formal-kernel proof, new κ or selected-frontier change is claimed. [TASK.json](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b4594222a4b3b97404f9ef1d0b03b71ae2c6768/research/two-site-caller-fusion/TASK.json) records the next questions and blockers. Reopening requires a changed graph/response/contract with a complete original-input and paid invoice.

- Official export/integrity and read-only Git-free normal/-O replay with empty PATH; source bytes/modes/inodes unchanged.
- Complete actual admitted reconstruction; separate independent source transport/gluing proof, every used native recipe/embedding/Gaussian phase, full serialized inverses and all current counters.
- Every field of all four author and independent path-certificate fixtures, including edges, source chronology, signed holonomies, phases and literal inverses. No proposer search or cold witness synthesis rerun.
- Wrong pointer, f2-only phase, omitted monomial/inverse edge, reversed noncommuting order, wrong routing and missing BANK_SWAP controls reject; equivalent phase gauges and bank-permuted two-sided isolation pass.

Transport is0.99MB; logical aliases total24.47MB expanded or18.22MB by unique payload. Compression/aliasing does not reduce mathematical review scope. All original and executed bytes are authenticated, without network, executable data or bytecode-cache dependence. Separate Codex reviews are AI review, not human/formal acceptance.

The full natural [Registered research packages workflow39269926756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39269926756) is **completed/success** at exact head `7b4594222a4b3b97404f9ef1d0b03b71ae2c6768`.
